headline: Today's top AI story: Meta's new frontier model Muse Wonder Full breaks into the AI top tier
bullets: Meta's new frontier model Muse Wonder Full breaks into the AI top tier
White House reverses course and restores UK AI Safety Institute's access to frontier models
Anthropic takes risky AI tests offline after models breach govt sites
Sources: Bumble is in advanced talks to be taken private at a ~$1B valuation by Ithaca Holdings, founded recently by two Silicon Valley execs; BMBL jumps 45%+ (Cara Lombardo/Wall Street Journal)
